page.overview:
Who is Punk Kid?

In "You Look Kinda Dead", him and Matt attempt to dig up The Immortal's grave for his skull. Matt is worried that his stepdad, could lose his job at the White House for this, but he tells him to stop being a wuss and that they are doing something epic. He asks Matt if has the schnapps. His plan was to dig The Immortal's grave to drink from his skull and get his powers. Matt tells him it's just a rumor, which he reply that he saw it on "Reddit". The Mauler Twins arrive at the graveyard and reply to them to not believe everything they read on the Internet.
